title: Fix sign-in name input glitch by preventing TanStack Router recreation

requirements.text: Fix the login/sign-in form glitch where the name input clears itself and blinks while typing by ensuring the TanStack Router instance is not recreated on every render in `frontend/src/App.tsx` (keep the router stable across renders while still receiving updated auth context).

quotes: The sign and flow it's still glitching I cannot sign in every time I try to type a name in the box It's removing it itself and just blinking as if it's a glitch

acceptanceCriteria: On the login page (`/`), typing into the "Your Name" input does not clear, does not lose focus, and does not visually blink/flicker on each keystroke.
The `LoginPage` component state (e.g., `displayName`) is preserved while typing (i.e., the route component is not remounted on each keystroke).

Navigation/route-guards still work correctly: unauthenticated users are redirected to `/` when attempting to access `/user/*` or `/admin/*`, and authenticated users can reach their dashboards as before.
No changes are made to any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

constraints: Frontend must not edit immutable paths: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Keep the backend unchanged unless strictly necessary for the input glitch (this issue should be resolved purely in the frontend).
nonGoals: Redesigning the login page UI/visual theme beyond what is necessary to stop the input from clearing/blinking.
Changing the authentication model (local identity + display name) or adding email/password auth.
Addressing unrelated known issues (e.g., pre-trip checklist glitches) unless they are directly implicated by the router remount issue.
